reason: When I buy solar I will ask my brother and the neighbours who they used and go to that man, not to an app I saw on my phone. Maybe my son abroad would like it, but this month I am not sending any request.
objection: The prices follow the dollar every week, so written offers from strangers mean little by the time I have the money, and I heard mixed things about my neighbour's system even with someone he knew. Why would companies I have never heard of be better?
would_change_my_mind: If someone in my family or a neighbour used it and told me the company was honest and the price they wrote was the price they charged.
